\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,positioning,shapes.multipart}
\begin{document}
\tikzset{
  pipeline/.style={
    rectangle split,
    rectangle split horizontal,
    rectangle split parts=5,
    rectangle split empty part width=2pt,
    rectangle split empty part width=4pt,
    rectangle split empty part height=.6ex,
    rectangle split empty part height=1.6ex,
    rectangle split empty part depth=.4ex,
    rectangle split part fill={blue!12,white,green!14,white,orange!16},
    draw,
    thick,
    inner sep=3pt
  },
  action/.style={draw,rounded corners=2pt,minimum width=18mm,minimum height=8mm}
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[>=Latex]
  \node[pipeline] (pipe) {Read\nodepart{two}\nodepart{three}Check\nodepart{four}\nodepart{five}Write};
  \node[action] (retry) at (-2.1,-1.6) {Retry};
  \node[action] (commit) at (2.1,-1.6) {Commit};
  \draw[->,thick,blue] (pipe.two) -- (retry);
  \draw[->,thick,orange] (pipe.four) -- (commit);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
